title: A member sees the organization AWS spend in the workspace
description:
**Phase 4 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the ceiling story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the alert story and the stop story
- **Unblocks:** the cost readout task, in the market research epic

---
Month-to-date spend against the ceiling, visible in the workspace rather than only in an alert that arrives once.

**This is a reason to buy, not a safety feature bolted on.** A beta agent that runs a Linux computer on your own AWS account is exactly the thing a buyer is nervous about, and showing them the number continuously is the answer to the nervousness. It belongs on the pitch page as a feature.

It also produces the measurement the market research epic needs: what an organization computer actually costs to run for a month, from real organizations rather than an estimate.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Organization spend ceiling

  Scenario: The workspace shows spend against the ceiling
    Given an enabled organization with recorded AWS spend this month
    When a member opens the workspace
    Then they see the month-to-date AWS spend
    And they see the monthly ceiling

  Scenario: An organization with no spend yet reads clearly
    Given an enabled organization provisioned today with no recorded spend
    When a member opens the workspace
    Then the month-to-date AWS spend reads as zero rather than unknown
